pdfembed_description: Embed PDF files into pages with the pdf tag.
embed_pdf_no_permission: The last editor of this page did not have the right to $1.
embed_pdf_blank_file: The URL or file path given to embed a PDF is blank.
embed_pdf_invalid_file: The URL or file path $1 does not exist.
embed_pdf_invalid_url: The URL $1 is not a valid URL of a PDF.
embed_pdf_invalid_relative_domain: The URL $1 has no host; relative URLs cannot be embedded.
embed_pdf_domain_not_white: The host $1 is not on the list of allowed PDF hosts.
embed_pdf_domain_black: The host $1 is on the list of blocked PDF hosts.
